purpose: Choose at most one additional Phase-1 optimization arm without inspecting terminal BF16-1:30 or FP32-1:12 validation, movement, or arena results.
unobserved_when_sealed: v2_fp32_1_12 terminal validation, movement, and arena

behavior_definitions.root_top1_retained: candidate minus matched Hero-1 is at least -0.01 on the frozen 8192-position validation pool
behavior_definitions.root_top1_material_regression: candidate minus matched Hero-1 is at most -0.03 on the frozen 8192-position validation pool
behavior_definitions.arena_clearly_worse: the paired score confidence interval lies wholly below 0.5; a low-power point estimate alone is not decisive
behavior_definitions.movement_safe: trunk relative-delta L2 is below 0.005 and global relative-delta L2 is below 0.01

ordered_decision_tree.condition: FP32-1:12 passes the frozen curve, validation, and movement screens; retains root top-1; and its 16-pair arena is not clearly worse
ordered_decision_tree.action: Launch no additional Phase-1 arm; advance FP32-1:12 to Phase 2 as a behavioral candidate.

ordered_decision_tree.condition: BF16-1:30 retains root top-1 while full-FP32-1:30 has the already-observed material root-top1 regression
ordered_decision_tree.action: Attribute the leading contrast to whole-model precision. Implement encoder_fp32_master. Launch encoder-only FP32 at ratio 1:12 if FP32-1:12 movement is safe, otherwise at ratio 1:30.

ordered_decision_tree.condition: BF16-1:30 itself has a material root-top1 regression
ordered_decision_tree.action: Treat schedule/decay or main learning rate as implicated. Launch the existing full-FP32 ratio-1:12 arm with main-LR multiplier 0.75; do not launch hybrid precision first.

ordered_decision_tree.condition: BF16-1:30 root-top1 delta is between -0.03 and -0.01, or evidence is otherwise ambiguous
ordered_decision_tree.action: Launch the minimal encoder-only FP32 ratio-1:30 contrast.
